business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cross-Border Physical Consignment of Shredded Non-Ferrous Scrap

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States-Oman Free Trade Agreement (Chapter 10 Investment, in force 1 January 2009)
People's Republic of China-Oman Agreement on the Promotion and Protection of Investments
GCC Unified Economic Agreement and GCC Investment Law chapters applicable to Oman

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Combating Money Laundering and Financing Terrorism Law, Royal Decree No. 30/2016, as amended by Royal Decree No. 7/2019; Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, Articles 155 and 171; Ministerial Decision No. 2/2021 on Disclosure of Beneficial Owners; AML/CFT Implementing Regulations and directives issued by the National Centre for Financial Information. The Single Person Company is required to identify, verify, and file the natural-person beneficial owner who ultimately owns or controls 25% or more of equity, voting rights, profits, or strategic control.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Shareholder's valid international passport and national ID (commercial registration copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / Civil Registration Office of shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or equivalent corporate existence certificate for any corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry in the country of incorporation of the corporate UBO

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarised Power of Attorney and board/shareholder resolution appointing the Oman incorporation agent and local registered office provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in the place of signing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication followed by consular legalization at the Oman Embassy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft constitutional documents including Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in Arabic with English translation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporation law firm / certified Arabic legal translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization of translator's certificate and foreign signing; Arabic version before Oman courts

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each UBO, manager, and authorised signatory against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, OFAC country/entity lists, UK HMT sanctions list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and the Oman National Centre for Financial Information national CFT watchlist. Enhanced due diligence is triggered for politically exposed persons, senior foreign political figures, their family members and close associates; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence must be obtained for any PEP exposure. Because the business scope is cross-border physical consignment of shredded non-ferrous scrap metal, a 30-day transactional look-back and dual counterparty screening for metal-smuggling/sanctions-avoidance risk is mandated before filing incorporation documents.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy — Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion commercial name reservation service (https://investeasy.gov.om)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official trade-name must be in Arabic. Foreign-language names, including the English corporate name, must be transliterated into Arabic according to foreign-name transcription rules adopted by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion. The Arabic name is the authoritative registered name; an English transliteration may be shown as a supplementary name if identical in substance. The mandatory suffix for a Single Person Company is '(Single Person Company) LLC' in English or the corresponding Arabic form, indicating limited liability. The name must not be identical, misleadingly similar, or confusingly close to an existing registered commercial name or a protected trademark in Oman.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Ministry rejects a proposed name, the applicant or incorporation agent may file an administrative grievance with the Director General of Commercial Registration through the Invest Easy portal within 30 days of the rejection notice, specifying the ground of rebuttal and the legal basis for distinctiveness. If the Director General does not reverse the decision within 15 working days, a further grievance may be addressed to the Ministerial Grievance Committee. Final relief is available in the Administrative Court in Muscat within 60 days of the final ministerial administrative decision. Name reservation is not renewable; a rejected applicant may submit a new candidate name only after the initial reservation reference is closed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a Single Person Company engaged in licensed cross-border scrap metal consignment trading, a virtual office or service-address-only accommodation is not acceptable as the registered commercial address. MOCIIP requires a physical place of business in Oman, capable of receiving official notices, maintaining statutory books, and being visited by commercial, customs, and tax inspectors. A virtual address may be used only as a supplementary correspondence facility after a verified physical Oman address has been registered.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law – Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (New Companies Law), Chapter on Incorporation and provisions governing the Single Person Company (SPC).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Companies Registration Directorate, via the Invest Easy electronic portal (business.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: SPC Incorporation Application (Form SPC-INC) submitted with a notarized Memorandum of Association through the Invest Easy portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Single Person Company under Omani law. The sole shareholder determines the capital amount in the Memorandum of Association, and that capital must be deposited into a corporate bank account in Oman; a bank certificate confirming receipt of the capital is required for the registration filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the sole shareholder of the Single Person Company, that the entire share subscription under the Memorandum of Association be and is hereby ratified and accepted; that the initial paid-up capital be deposited in the Company's bank account as evidenced by the bank's capital certificate; that the registered office of the Company be established at the address indicated in the Memorandum, effective immediately; that [Full Name] be and is hereby appointed General Manager, with power to open bank accounts, execute contracts, obtain licenses, and make tax filings; and that the General Manager's actions to implement these resolutions are ratified, retroactively and prospectively, in all respects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve Approved Corporate Name and Initial Trade Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP – Companies Registration Directorate through Invest Easy portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to Invest Easy via an authorized service provider or directly, submit one proposed Arabic and one English trade name for the SPC, select the legal form 'Single Person Company', and pay the reservation fee. The system automatically checks name availability and objectionable use indicators prior to submission.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Passport copy of the proposed general manager
Draft Memorandum of Association with proposed corporate objects
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or conflict, file a revised name reservation within 5 working days using the same application reference; no additional fee is charged for one resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarize the Memorandum of Association and Obtain Legal Attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public attesting under the Ministry of Justice, Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Take the Arabic-drafted Memorandum of Association before a licensed notary public, who verifies the identities and legal capacity of the shareholder(s), confirms the capital structure, and issues a notarized original. If the shareholder is a foreign natural person outside Oman, execute a power of attorney and have the memorandum notarized and legalized at the Omani diplomatic mission, then transmit to the local attorney in Oman.
required_dossiers: Reserved name certificate or online reservation reference
Passports of shareholder and proposed officers
Power of attorney executed by the overseas shareholder if any
Draft Arabic Memorandum of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the document for correction, remedy the noted deficiencies (typos, incorrect capital amount, defective objects) and resubmit for notarization; additional notary fees may apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open a Corporate Bank Account and Deposit Paid-up Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any licensed commercial bank operating in Oman (e.g., Bank Muscat, National Bank of Oman, HSBC Oman)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized Memorandum of Association and the approved name certificate to the chosen bank, complete the account-opening application, undergo the Know-Your-Customer (KYC) review, and transfer the agreed paid-up capital from the shareholder's account to the SPC bank account. Obtain a capital deposit certificate issued by the bank stating the amount credited.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum of Association
Name approval certificate
Passport copies of beneficial owner and authorized signatory
Detailed business plan and declaration of source of funds
Letter from MoCIIP or Invest Easy reference for SPC incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests further due diligence, provide an audited or notarized source-of-wealth statement, underlying shipping contracts, or utility bills proving the physical business premise; re-file if the bank rejects the initial application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit Full Incorporation Application to MoCIIP via Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attach all notarized corporate documents to the Invest Easy incorporation application, including the bank capital deposit certificate and registered office lease. Complete the corporate governance forms, designate the general manager, and authorize the legal representative to sign the electronic return. Submit the application and pay the registration fee by card or bank transfer.
required_dossiers: Bank capital deposit certificate
Notarized Memorandum of Association (Arabic)
Registered office lease agreement in Oman and attested 'No-Objection Certificate' from the lessor
Copy of the approved trade name reservation
Passport copies and residency visas of shareholder and manager (if resident)
Board resolution or sole shareholder resolution appointing the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MoCIIP issues a query or a deficiency notice, submit the required clarifications or amended documents through the Invest Easy portal; the filing is automatically re-assessed and a decision is issued within 5 working days of the response.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Commercial Registration Certificate and Company Establishment Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the online application, download and print the electronic Commercial Registration (CR) certificate and the Certificate of Incorporation from the Invest Easy dashboard. Verify that all corporate details (name, address, capital, manager) are correctly reflected. Collect the original stamped Company Establishment Document from the MoCIIP customer service wing if physical copies are required by banks or licensing authorities.
required_dossiers: Incorporation fee payment receipt
Approved electronic filing record
Any documents requested by MoCIIP during the final review
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If minor typographical errors appear, file a rectification request through Invest Easy with a statutory declaration from the general manager; rectification is issued within 3 working days and does not require a fresh incorporation filing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Directorate General of Industry, in coordination with the Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (PEIE) if the facility is to be located in an industrial estate.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License for Non-Ferrous Scrap Metal Recycling and Trading

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (EA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A – Full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) required for recycling and waste-processing facilities with metal shredding and potential hazardous emissions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with Oman Ministerial Decision No. 18/93 environmental standards; ambient air emissions for particulate matter, heavy metals, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) must meet the applicable National Ambient Air Quality Standards; hazardous waste storage and transfer must follow the Hazardous Waste Management Rules requiring dedicated containment, labeling, and manifest consignment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority, Royal Oman Police, issues the Fire Safety and Fire Fighting Equipment Certificate after inspection of the premises and verification of automatic detection, extinguishing systems, and emergency evacuation routes. The Ministry of Labour (Public Authority for Social Insurance applies separately) grants occupational health clearance confirming adequate lighting, ventilation, safe machinery guarding, personal protective equipment, and compliance with labour safety codes.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), Sultanate of Oman; electronic filing and registration through the official e-Services Tax Portal (https://taxoman.gov.om), complemented by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion for Commercial Registration and the Royal Oman Police Customs Directorate for export documentation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) must first complete Commercial Registration at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion; thereafter the authorized signatory registers online on the OTA Tax Portal using the official electronic authentication (e-ID or civil ID), completes the combined business and VAT registration forms, and obtains a single Tax Identification Number (TIN) plus a dedicated VAT registration number where the registration threshold is met or exceeded. No minimum capital deposit is required for SPC registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the resident Omani SPC is treated as a separate taxable juridical person under the Oman Income Tax Law; there is no pass-through or look-through status for foreign-owned limited companies, and taxable income is computed and taxed at the entity level at the standard corporate rate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is available under Omani tax law. Limited statutory election rights exist only for VAT purposes: related Omani businesses may apply to form a VAT group, and Omani non-resident suppliers may choose to nominate a tax representative for VAT registration and compliance.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax pursuant to the Oman VAT Law issued by Sultani Decree No. 121/2020 and its Executive Regulations)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration is triggered at annual taxable supplies of OMR 38,000; voluntary registration is available from OMR 19,000; non-resident persons making taxable supplies subject to the reverse-charge mechanism in Oman are separately obligated to register through a tax representative.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman has not introduced a mandatory real-time fiscal clearance or digital-stamping e-invoicing API as of the current compliance cycle; taxpayers must issue valid VAT tax invoices, maintain electronic records of supplies and exports, and make such records accessible to OTA on demand.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported by the Omani SPC to a customer outside Oman, or to goods other than those for the recipient's consumption within Oman where transit through Oman is solely export-related, provided the supplier obtains and retains clear export evidence, issues a valid zero-rated VAT invoice, and the exported goods leave Oman within the timeframe stated in the VAT law and Executive Regulations. Services directly and exclusively linked to exported goods, and related export logistics services, may also be zero-rated where the conditions of the VAT law are satisfied.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration endorsed by the Royal Oman Police Customs Directorate
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing dispatch of the shredded non-ferrous copper wire consignment to a non-GCC destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or authenticated SWIFT/TT credit evidence proving receipt of export sale proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: OTA may subject export zero-rating claims to retrospective audit; failure to substantiate the export within the legally required period triggers compulsory VAT uplift at the 5% rate plus late-payment penalties, and intentionally false or fraudulent zero-rating is prosecuted as tax evasion. Penalties under Omani tax law include monetary fines of up to OMR 100,000, imprisonment of the responsible persons, and mandatory repayment of any wrongly refunded VAT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Oman maintains open currency convertibility on both current and capital accounts. The Omani Rial (OMR) is pegged to the US Dollar at 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD (official rate) with a narrow band of ±0.5%. Foreign-owned SPCs may freely credit/debit foreign-currency accounts. Profit and dividend remittance requires audited financials, a certified tax clearance certificate from the Oman Tax Authority, and corporate formation documents; no separate exchange-control approval is required. Countertrade or restrictive practices are statutorily prohibited for licensed trading companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose mandatory foreign-exchange surrender. Export receipts from scrap copper and other goods must be credited to the SPC's licensed bank account within 180 days from the date of the Customs Single Window export declaration. The exporter must match the SWIFT MT103 credit note to the bill of lading and commercial invoice. No conversion ratio applies; the holder may retain USD/EUR balances or convert to OMR at the official pegged rate. Failure to repatriate within the statutory window constitutes a violation under CBO's Foreign Exchange Circular (38/77) and can result in restricted access to trade facilities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (OMR/USD non-trading account for FDI injection)
Operational Account (multi-currency; SWIFT TT and trade LC facilities)
Operational Account (trade settlement; deferred LC and receivable discounting)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (for UBO with existing HSBC global relationship)
Operational Account (local OMR clearing; low cross-border fee)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore digital EMI (electronic money institution) service providers are not permitted to operate in Oman without a CBO license. Foreign EMIs such as Airwallex, Wise, or iBan First may only act as unregulated payment facilitators and cannot execute OMR-denominated settlements or maintain capital escrow accounts. All cross-border trade funds must transact through a CBO-licensed commercial bank or registered exchange house.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the SPC's nominated director (or UBO) is mandatory for first-time account opening at all Omani tier-1 banks. A local signatory with Power of Attorney may satisfy the interview requirement if the foreign director provides a notarized and apostilled POA and appears via videoconference for the compliance interview; however, most banks require the UBO to visit in-country if no established relationship exists with the bank group.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inability to verify physical chain of custody for recycled scrap copper shipments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Batch-level supply chain pack: commercial contracts with registered suppliers, operator weighbridge tickets, lot-level copper content assay from a NABL/ISO-17025 laboratory, Customs export declaration, and a shipping line non-negotiable copy of bill of lading.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags (consistent under/over-invoicing, mismatched HS codes, or recycling sector activities).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: LME Grade A copper benchmark price history, inspection certificate issued by SGS/Intertek/Cotecna, independent pre-shipment survey, and bank-compliant transfer pricing analysis with margin benchmarking.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unidentified third-party payment routing from the buyer or a collection account not disclosed in the invoice.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Swift MT103 matching the invoice reference, BOI (beneficiary ownership) confirmations, an indemnity/compelling declaration showing the commercial reason for tripartite payments, and irrevocable LC from the buyer's issuing bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative media or sanctions exposure on the UBO/SPC related to conflict metals or dual-use scrap.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Archived negative media report with a qualified legal opinion, OFAC/EU/CBO sanctions screening certificate, declaration of no-due-diligence gaps from a licensed corporate agent, and audited financial statements for two prior fiscal years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Failure to obtain the mandatory MoCIIP scrap-trading license or omission of environmental/export permits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified license from Oman's Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), the Trade Establishment Code certificate under the Business Registration System, and an Environment Permit for non-ferrous recycling operations issued by the Environment Authority.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholder capital injection must be routed through a CBO-licensed bank using SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'EQUI' (Direct Investment) or 'GTR' (General Trade). The funds should be credited to the SPC's Capital Escrow Account (non-operational) and matched against the registered FDI declaration in the Oman Business Portal. The Oman Tax Authority and MoCIIP must receive the inward remittance notification within 30 days; the SPC may subsequently reallocate funds to its operational account for working capital after conversion to OMR at the official 0.3846 pegged rate (buy side). The capital injection cannot be pledged or withdrawn for the duration of the 'Locked-in Period' applicable to foreign-owned SPCs (normally two years).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements are cleared primarily through (i) SWIFT MT103 (wire transfers) for spot supplier payments, (ii) irrevocable documentary letters of credit (SWIFT MT700) for scrap copper import settlements under UCP600, and (iii) MT202 and MT199 for correspondent bank funding and treasury adjustments. For local OMR settlement, Oman's RTGS (OMR-GROSS) clears high-value transactions; retail payments use the OmanNET clearing switch. All outbound trade remittances require the green-channel resolution of Customs export records and the SPC's trade finance facility approval.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency Forwards (USD/OMR, EUR/OMR, CNY/OMR) executed with CBO-licensed onshore banks
Cross-currency swaps for trade-debt consolidation with tenors aligned to the LC payment calendar
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) booked offshore for third-country pairs (e.g., CNY/USD, INR/USD) where no OMR principal is settled
FX swaps (USD vs OMR) for overnight liquidity repricing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Register Renewal Certificate for the Single Person Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) / Invest Easy Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the expiry date stated on the current Commercial Register certificate; the renewal window opens 30 days before expiry and closes on the expiry date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a penalty of approximately OMR 100 (USD 260); continued non-renewal for 60 days triggers suspension of the Commercial Register, and prolonged inactivity may lead to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and accompanying financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year; for a calendar-year SPC, no later than 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file permits the Tax Authority to issue an ex-parte assessment; administrative penalties may reach OMR 5,000 (USD 13,000), plus late-payment penalties on any assessed tax.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Register Confirmation and shareholder continuity declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry / Oman Beneficial Ownership Database
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted together with the annual Commercial Register renewal; any transfer of SPC shares triggers a UBO register update within 30 days after the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update beneficial-ownership information is punishable by fines ranging from OMR 500 to OMR 5,000 (USD 1,300 to USD 13,000) under the Commercial Companies Law and AML/CFT regulations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An Omani SPC engaged in commercial trading must have annual financial statements independently audited by an auditor licensed in Oman unless it qualifies for the small-business exemption under MoCIIP guidance, generally annual revenue below OMR 250,000 (USD 650,000) and total assets below OMR 100,000 (USD 260,000). The Tax Authority may require audited accounts for any taxpayer in the enhanced-risk non-ferrous scrap trade regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Oman; SMEs may elect IFRS for SMEs with the approval of the relevant authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SPC must maintain an accurate UBO register at its registered office. The shareholder or manager must confirm the UBO schedule on each annual Commercial Register renewal and file an updated register within 30 days after any share transfer; the filing must identify all individuals owning or controlling 25% or more of the company.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None for a standard onshore foreign-owned SPC. The regime offers only (i) a concessional 3% small-business rate for qualifying Omani-owned SMEs and (ii) free-zone tax holidays (e.g., up to 30 years in Duqm SEZ) confined to licensed free-zone undertakings. The onshore SPC in this structure pays the flat 15% rate on total taxable income.
